===== [p65-67] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > PROCESS JOB QUEUE Command Matrix (2块) =====
--[p67]-- Each process job defined has its own instance of the process job state model.
The PROCESS JOB (or Lot) is the processing job for the machine specifying and tracking the processing mostly to be applied to the wafers that are provided as input via either Track or Wafer Carrier.
For optimized processing PROCESS JOBS can be queued in the system where they normally will be processed on a FIFO-basis. The sequence of PROCESS JOBS can however be changed by means of separate commands given by either the host or the operator.
--[p65 [表]]-- The following matrix shows which PROCESS JOB Queue commands can be given in which process job queue state.
Table 2.8 PROCESS JOB QUEUE Command Matrix.
Command | Q1 | Q2 | Q3 | Q4
Stop queue | X | X | x
ASML Confidential
The PROCESS JOB State Model (see Figure 2.9) gives an overview of all states of a process job in the system. Each process job defined has its own instance of the process job state model.

===== [p63-63] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > STOP QUEUE (1块) =====
--[p63]-- The active process job(s) (i.e. process jobs having a wafer being accepted by the machine) will be completed; all further process job processing will be terminated. After this the only process job activity can be adding process jobs; production can only be restarted with a start queue command via GUI.

===== [p201-202] CAPABILITIES AND SCENARIOS > 202 SECS Interface Manual for Release 5.0.0 (7块) =====
--[p201]-- If the option “Linked Litho” is installed, the waferlD may be set by a message from the track. If the track message interface is unavailable or disabled, the system will assign a default ID. This ID can
be one of the following: <PRJOBID> + “.” +<Wafer sequence number> for a wafer provided by the track, under the
condition that it can be linked to a valid process job. “NO_LOT”+”."+<Wafer sequence number> for a wafer provided by the track, that cannot be
linked to a valid process job
--[p202]-- See “Variable Item Descriptions” on page 231.
Where Used S1F12
SWLASTCUSTOME | Format: 20
RUPGRADE Description | Name of most recent installed customer patch.
Values | If no patch exists an empty string (““) is returned. Otherwise, the name is returned with a miximum
Where Used | S14F1 | length of 25 characters.
Data items (T-Z)
TEXT | Format: 20
Description | A single line of 1599 characters maximum.
Where Used | S10F1, F3, F5, F9
TIAACK | Format: 10 Equipment Acknowledge Code, 1 byte.
Description | Values | 0 = Everything correct
--[p201]-- 1 = Service does not exist
3 = At least one parameter is invalid 4 = Acknowledge, service will be performed with completion notified later with parameters for
response
5 = Service is not completed or prohibited
7 - 63 Reserved | 6 = No such object exists
Where Used S14F20, F21
SVCNAME | Format: 20
Description Values | Service name provided on specified object asking by host:
“MoveReticle”

===== [p126-127] CAPABILITIES AND SCENARIOS > Data Collection (SEMI E30) (5块) =====
--[p126]-- Capability
This capability allows the host to monitor system activity via event data collection, variable data collection or status data collection.
Data is organized in predefined or host defined report(s) containing lists of variables . These lists include state variables , equipment constants , and/or data variables :
Equipment Constants (factory or machine constants), set the general processing (factory) environment. For example, enable event reporting.
--[p127]-- Events are occurrences detectable by the system.
For example, completion of a host-initiated command, a process state transition, or certain operator actions.
The following are the data collection types:
• Event Data Collection. When an event occurs, the system sends the defined report(s), containing the state variable values and data variable values .
• Variable Data Collection. The host can request the defined reports (variable data collection ) by referencing the event ID or the report ID .
--[p127]-- For example, enable event reporting.
Equipment Constants are seldom changed. Equipment constants are normally not associated with process programs. Equipment constant values are always valid and are stored in non-volatile memory.
Status Variables (read-out meter or lamp) contain information about system states. For example, control mode, and processing. Status variable values are always valid and available from the system.
--[p127]-- Status variable values are always valid and available from the system.
Data Variables (sampled read-out) are dynamic system parameters that are valid only with the occurrence of designated Collection Events. For example, the alarm ID of an current alarm is set. If an, for that event, invalid Data Variable is collected, the Data Variable value is not defined.
The reports (data collection formats) are linked to one or more events . Events are occurrences detectable by the system.
--[p127]-- Data variable values are not always valid, since events may not have occurred or occurred a long time ago.
Status Data Collection.Up on request of the host, the system sends the state-variable values (i.e. state data collection ).

Process Job | Lot
Recipe Body | Self-contained Recipe (or Recipe)

Formatted Process Program | Recipe Exchange

===== [p40-40] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • NOT COMMUNICATING (1块) =====
--[p40]-- The system (or host) sends requests regularly to try to establish communication. Host messages (except S1F13, S1F14, and S9Fx) are ignored. In this state, only messages S1F13, S1F14, or S9Fx will be sent (or S1F1 messages in case of the track interface). Selected (primary) messages that have been initiated by the system must be spooled.

===== [p54-54] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • CUSTOMER ENGINEER AVAILABLE (1块) =====
--[p54]-- The Customer Engineer is available for handling the situation.

===== [p139-140] CAPABILITIES AND SCENARIOS > Material Handling (SEMI E87, E90 and E109) (4块) =====
--[p139]-- Capability
Material movement includes:
• Movement of material
• WIP tracking
Material Handling requires the remote control and data collection options. This means that no dedicated stream 4 functions are used.
Material movement involves the transfer of objects (Work In Process (WIP), single wafers, cassettes, or expendable materials) from system A to system B, possibly using a transfer agent such as robot arms on a fixed track, Automatic Guided Vehicles (AVGs), or conveyor belts).
--[p140]-- Each transfer object has a unique ID. Sometimes material is grouped into carriers, which are the transfer objects for efficient transportation. An operator can also be involved in the movement.
Material movement transactions occur at two levels:
Macro level. The host informs each party that material will be transferred, what the direction of the transfer will be, and at which port the transfer will occur. Each party must inform the host when ready to transfer.
--[p140]-- This micro level material movement can happen apart from the host.
It can be implemented using SECS-II messages (directly or indirectly via host) or with a direct peer-to-peer interface using optical signals, parallel I/O, or another method.
--[p140]-- Each party must inform the host when ready to transfer.
The host issues a command to start the transfer to one of the parties, usually the transfer agent. Each party reports to the host when its portion of the transfer is complete. The host may, in turn, need to inform the parties that their transfer ports have been released.
Micro Level. A transfer sometimes requires that each party performs a sequence of actions, which must be synchronized. This micro level material movement can happen apart from the host.

--[p38]-- This chapter discusses the functional behavior of the SECS models. It addresses their states and state transitions. Additional information like a command matrix may be given.

===== [p39-39] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > COMMUNICATIONS State Model (3块) =====
--[p39]-- The equipment can establish a communication connection with host or track. Communication between host or track and equipment can be established when the systems communications substate is NOT COMMUNICATING.
In the NOT COMMUNICATING communications sub-state, the equipment periodically attempts to send an Establish Communications Request message at the interval specified by the equipment constant ESTABLISHCOMMUNICATIONSTIMER.
--[p39]-- To keep the link, the system periodically sends a heartbeat message (S1F1) to host or track. This heartbeat is user configurable with the Equipment Constant HEARTBEAT.
--[p39]-- The transition to state COMMUNICATING is made after communication is established. Communication is formally established when one of these conditions has been satisfied:
The equipment sends an Establish Communications Request to host or track, and receives an Establish Communications Acknowledge (within the transaction timeout period).
The equipment receives an Establish Communications Request from host or track and sends an Establish Communications Acknowledge.

===== [p53-53] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • • • • TEST LOT ACTIVE (1块) =====
--[p53]-- The execution of a Test Process job is active.

===== [p117-117] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > Exception Condition States (1块) =====
--[p117]-- • REPORTING
Represents the reporting state.
• • CLEARED
No active error situation is found.
• • SET
An error situation found and active.
• • • NOT\_POSTED
Error is not (yet) sent to the host.
• • • POSTED
The error has been sent to the host.

===== [p113-113] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > PodNotifcation (2块) =====
--[p113]-- With this service the host indicates the reticle pod information to the equipment about a pod that is going to be received on an unspecified load port. This also enables 'equipment based verification' of the Pod ID at the moment the pod arrives on a load port. Even though there are 2 load ports; only one ‘open’ PodNotification (i.e. Pod not yet received) will be supported.
--[p113]-- A new PodNotification, during an ‘open’ PodNotification, will therefor be only accepted after having received a CancelPodNotification.
Whenever the PodNotification contains a slot-map with slots that are ‘undefined’ or whenever the contentmap conflicts with the slot-map in the same message, the service is accepted, but the behavior of the software is undefined (this may cause errors the software to malfunction at a later time).

===== [p118-118] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > MESSAGE INPUT / OUTPUT State Model (Linked Litho) (1块) =====
--[p118]-- The TWINSCAN now controls two HSMS connections:
1. One connections used by a host for remote control
2. One connection is used for transferring wafer IDs to/from a supported wafer track.
The message interface between scanner and track can be enabled / disabled for input or output of wafers independently. Events and states from this model are visible to the host. These models are used to control the Linked Litho interface.

===== [p130-154] CAPABILITIES AND SCENARIOS > Capability (35块) =====
--[p130]-- This capability provides a method for the host to read and to change the value of selected equipment constants on the equipment.
Pending on commercial option SECS\_EQUIPMENT\_CONSTANTS, the host may request to get or set the value of one or more Equipment Constants by their IDs (ECIDs). In addition, it is possible to retrieve information e.g. the name for one or more ECIDs.
--[p130]-- The equipment establishes a trace report as instructed by the host (S2F23).
For a trace report (S6F1), the host designates a name for the trace report (TRID), a time interval for data sampling (DSPER), the total number of samples to be taken (TOTSMP), the number of samples per trace report (REPGSZ), and a listing of which data will be sent with the report (SVIDs). The number of trace reports sent to the host is determined by the total samples divided by reporting group size (TOTSMP/REPGSZ).

===== [p55-63] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > PROCESS State Transitions (56块) =====
--[p63]-- The PROCESS JOB QUEUE determines if processing on process jobs is progressing or not.
As long as the queue is not running the only process job processing activity can be addition of new process jobs to the queue and/or deletion of process jobs from the queue (meaning that only new validated process jobs can be added; all existing process jobs will keep their state). The queue must be manually enabled once (after a system re-start).

--[p63]-- The queue must be manually enabled once (after a system re-start).
When a queue is enabled the machine must be able to run all process jobs that are entered in a continuous flow (streaming) without the need for further operator attention (except for alarm / exception situations and off-line maintenance).
For execution of preventive maintenance, laser gas refills or special measurements, as far as automatically scheduled by the machine, the queue can be halted.

--[p55]-- There are a number of transitions into a PROCESSING ACTIVE state that are determined by the ‘History’. This means that the system ‘remembers’ its history which is called ‘processing active history’ in the following state transitions. This history should always have a value for ‘PROCESS’. The PROCESS history is needed for returning from the PAUSE state. The process active history should however be reset at the moment the IDLE or INIT process state is entered.

===== [p70-70] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • ABORTING (1块) =====
--[p70]-- After an ‘abort process job’ command or equipment triggered default recovery action ‘abort process job’ the equipment activities are being stopped in this state. Material related to the process job will remain at their locations.

===== [p88-88] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > WAFER QUALIFICATION States (1块) =====
--[p88]-- • NOT REJECTED
Normal situation for a wafer.
• REJECTED
During the instantiation the wafer was indicated as a reject, processing of the wafer has failed or the related process job is stopped and the related wafers are cleared / skipped.

===== [p94-94] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > Re-qualifyReticle (2块) =====
--[p94]-- This allows the external triggering of an IRIS inspection. Up to 12 Re-qualifyReticle commands may be queued which will be executed on a FIFO-basis. Note that after inspection the Reticle will be returned to the secondary association location except when the reticle was located on IRIS when the inspection was started. Re-qualifyReticle requests are always accepted (queued) provided that the reticle object is instantiated, except when the Reticle object status is ID VERIFICATION FAILED.
--[p94]-- At execution the reticle object status is checked against the command matrix. The service is rejected when the object is not in the correct state according the command matrix. If the Re-qualifyReticle service is accepted then the result of the service is returned via the S14F21 completion event.
This service is not available on the NXE platform.

===== [p105-105] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • SLOT MAP VERIFICATION FAIL (1块) =====
--[p105]-- The SlotMap has been read by the equipment and has failed verification by the host (CancelPod). Note that this implicates that this state can only be reached after consultation of the Host; the equipment cannot reject the Pod by itself.

===== [p151-151] CAPABILITIES AND SCENARIOS > Clock (SEMI E30) (3块) =====
--[p151]-- Capability
The clock enables time synchronization between the host and the system.
Note
On UNIX systems, it is not easy to set the hardware clock. Special user access, not available during normal system operation, is necessary for security reasons. The clock capability is available as a SECS software clock. Thus the delta between the host time and the SUN clock is stored. UNIX system-time-related values such as actual file modification time may be different from the SECS software clock.
--[p151 [表]]-- Host requests time | S2F17 →
← S2F18 | System responds with <TIME> value
Scenario 4.96 Host instructs system to set time
Host instructs system to set time | S2F31 | →
System sets its internal reference to the value of <TIME> received
← | S2F32 | Acknowledge
--[p151 [表]]-- All communication with the SECS interface that has time stamps always contains the time reference with the host clock (by adding the delta).
This function affects only the SECS data/variable items , and . As a result of this time synchronization, time references made in another way can deviate from the SECS software clock. Time references to different sources interfere with the hosts capability to execute services.
Scenarios
Scenario 4.95 Host requests time
Host requests time | S2F17 →

===== [p49-51] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > SYSTEM State (RESERVATION State sub-model) Transitions (6块) =====
--[p51]-- The system can only be in one state at a time.
Thus, in situations when several activities take place in parallel, only one activity determines the process state of the system. Exposure is considered most important in the PROCESSING ACTIVE super state. This means that at the moment a wafer is found in the Wafer Exposure or Image Prepare phase, this will determine the process-state.
--[p51]-- This then means that when being in the Wafer Exposure or Image Prepare state and an exception halts the exposure the process state will change into PAUSE even when other (wafer) activities still continue.Of second importance within PROCESSING ACTIVE will be Wafer Prepare / Measure Prepare, followed by respectively UNLOAD, LOAD and finally SETTING\_UP / READY.
The Process job that determines the Process State (having material in the most important phase) is called the Main Lot.
--[p51]-- At moments where no Process job is ACTIVE there is no Main Lot.
During the processing of lots situations may be found where the processing of the Main Lot (see above priority ranking) is hampered. These situations then lead to an exception leading to a transition to a Pause state. The system is then paused until production can be resumed (note that this does not mean that exposure is resumed, a process job may also be stopped).
--[p51]-- Exceptions in this sense include e.g. ‘process job pause commands’, ‘waiting for wafer’ and ‘alarms detected by equipment’.
The Process State consists of 2 AND-ed states: The standard E30 model and the Halting Status submodel that is used for availability tracking; at the moment the production is halted due to an exception, the time can be measured in the various phases of recovery.
--[p51]-- Even when the exposure activity itself is halted because of an exception or pause, while still other load and/or unload and/or measurement/prepare activities are in progress, the Process state will be one of Wafer Exposure or Image Prepare!
--[p49 [表]]-- Table 2.5 SYSTEM State (RESERVATION State sub-model) Transition
# | Current State | CEID | Trigger | New (sub)state | Action | Comment
19.1 | RESERVED | 6319 | ASML(-authorized) engineer returns machine to production | NOT RESERVED
19.3 | RESERVED | 6319 | All ASML(-authorized) engineers are logged off by the operator bymeans of Return to Production fall back service | NOT RESERVED
The system can only be in one state at a time.

===== [p85-85] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • • PROCESSED (1块) =====
--[p85]-- The wafer has been processed properly (e.g. the possible number of reject exposures found is less than the specified maximum).

===== [p47-47] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • SYSTEM NOT ATTENDED (1块) =====
--[p47]-- There is no ASML(-authorized) engineer logged in.

===== [p106-106] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • POD-IN-ACCESS (1块) =====
--[p106]-- The reticle pod has been clamped and is being accessed / has been accessed.

===== [p96-96] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • • • IN USE (1块) =====
--[p96]-- The Reticle is selected to be used or is in use.

===== [p68-68] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > REORDER LOT (1块) =====
--[p68]-- A reorder command is invoked to reorder queued process jobs in the system.

===== [p88-88] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • RETRY (1块) =====
--[p88]-- Processing of the wafer failed (e.g. alignment problems) and is retried after having repeated the prealignment. During this phase this wafer is cycled through the equipment, pre-aligned and returned eventually to the exposure position. When other wafers are found in the equipment all measures are taken that the sequence of wafers is not disturbed (i.e. processing on the wafers is always in the sequence of wafer receipt).

===== [p90-90] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • BUSY (1块) =====
--[p90]-- One or more wafers have been sent or are inserted in the wafer carrier.

===== [p70-70] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • FULLY PROCESSED (= E40 PROCESS JOB COMPLETED) (1块) =====
--[p70]-- Process job report data is collected and reports are generated. Fully processed lots are considered being removed from the active queue.

===== [p90-92] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > WAFER CARRIER ACCESSING State Transitions (7块) =====
--[p92]-- Reticles must be available before a process job can start.
Reticles stay in the Pod on the Load Port until they are inspected (when IRIS is available) or used in a process job. In other situations the Reticles are stored in the IRL until they are inspected or used. Reticles can only be removed from the system if they are not assigned to the running process job. In some case however, it is necessary to remove assigned reticles from the system, for example, to clean reticles that have failed the particle inspection.
--[p92]-- The following sections describe the behavior, the related services and the attributes of a reticle in the system.
--[p90]-- # | Current State | CEID | Trigger | New (Sub-)State | Action | Comment

D.1 | SLOTS-VERIFIED | 6820 | When used for input wafers: the process jobis deleted before being taken in production | COMPLETE, OPEN | Close the carrier(when command isimplicit)

===== [p69-69] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • • PAUSING (1块) =====
--[p69]-- After a pause process job command the potentially staged & exposed wafers of the process job are moved out; for Test Lots the active tests in the queue will be completed; the remaining tests will be skipped. The exposure of the staged Wafers is completed as well.

===== [p206-206] CAPABILITIES AND SCENARIOS > Variable Items (1块) =====
--[p206]-- This section describes the variable items that are defined for the TWINSCAN system.
Note
ASCII items (format 20) consist only of printable characters (20 hex to 7e hex inclusive). The system is sensitive to upper and lower case characters.

===== [p44-44] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • SPOOL ACTIVE (1块) =====
--[p44]-- All primary messages for which the spooling has been enabled by the host are directed to the spooling area. Other primary messages except stream 1 are discarded. Discarded messages are not sent or spooled. The system still attempts to send secondary messages, but it discards them if they fail.
The SPOOL ACTIVE has two AND states: SPOOL LOAD and SPOOL UNLOAD.

===== [p84-84] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • TRANSPORT (1块) =====
--[p84]-- • • AT SOURCE The wafer is available for retrieval by the system.

===== [p95-105] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • WAITING FOR HOST (3块) =====
--[p95]-- The barcode of the reticle could not be read or the reticle barcode is read but the system cannot verify the information with an earlier provided Reticle Pod service (like Bind or PodNotification). The Host must check if the ID is read correctly.
--[p104]-- The pod ID has been read by the equipment successfully or unsuccessfully but has not yet been verified by the host.
--[p105]-- The equipment is waiting for input from the host on the SlotMap just read.

===== [p84-84] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • AT DESTINATION (1块) =====
--[p84]-- The wafer has been moved to its final destination.

===== [p85-85] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • • REJECTED (1块) =====
--[p85]-- The system has not processed the wafer properly.

Values The time is encoded in the following format: YYYYMMDDhhmmsscc YYYY = year 0000 to 9999 MM = month 01 to 12 DD = day 01 to 31 hh = hour 00 to 23 mm = minute 00 to 59 ss = second 00 to 59 cc = centisecond 00 to 99 Where Used S5F9, F11; S7F96; as attribute in S14F1; S16F7, F9

===== [p102-102] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > Bypass Slotmap (1块) =====
--[p102]-- See transition 14 reticle pod state model (part 1).
TRUE
The SlotMap verification is always successful.
FALSE

===== [p114-114] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > PodComplete (4块) =====
--[p114]-- When a Reticle inside the equipment exists that is outside the pod and not on the stage or in the IRL and has a secondary association with the pod and the robot does NOT contain a reticle that is associated with an other pod, the reticle is returned to the Pod.
The pod must be prepared for removal by means of ending all activities related to the pod as described above, followed by unclamping.
--[p114]-- Barcode readings for Reticles not yet scanned will be continued until the inventory is complete.
• When a Reticle is being transferred from/to the Pod, this transfer is completed first.
When Reticles inside the equipment exist with status IN USE (regardless of whether the reticle is in the Pod or being moved to the Pod or not), the service will be rejected (Command not valid in current state) (see: 2.8.7).
--[p114]-- When this service is received the equipment will try to prepare the Pod for unload.
When the equipment is making an inventory to determine the Content-Map via reading the Reticle barcode(s), the barcode reading for an individual Reticle is completed and this Reticle is returned into their associated storage location inside the Pod after the scan. Barcode readings for Reticles not yet scanned will be continued until the inventory is complete.
--[p114]-- When a Reticle inside the equipment exists that is outside the pod and not in the IRL and has a secondary association with the Pod while a reticle that is associated to an other Pod resides on the robot, the service is rejected with an error.

===== [p45-45] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • • SPOOL FULL (1块) =====
--[p45]-- The allocated spooling area is filled completely. The size of the spooling area depends on the value of the OVERWRITESPOOL equipment constant. The oldest spooled message is overwritten by the new primary message that must be spooled. New primary messages that should be spooled are not discarded and lost.

===== [p22-22] RELEASE UPGRADE > HSMS (SEMI E37) (3块) =====
--[p22]-- Only one device identification is supported.
The system does not allow the host to send SECS messages to other equipment through the TWINSCAN system.
• The maximum size for (multi-block) messages sent or received is 4 MB per message.
The HSMS protocol parameters are locally configurable as machine constants. The default settings and ranges are according to the SEMI standards. An overview of the SECS protocol related machine constants is given in Table 1.3. The defaults are shown between brackets.
--[p22]-- High-speed SECS Message Services (HSMS) SEMI E37 is a TCP/IP protocol via Ethernet used for high-speed communication. Messages are sent as contiguous streams of bytes. The message transfer protocol is implemented according to SEMI standards with these conditions:
• The maximum number of supported concurrent open transactions (host-initiated and equipment initiated requests) is 255.
Only one device identification is supported.

===== [p68-68] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > ABORT LOT (1块) =====
--[p68]-- A process job abort command is issued for an active process job. The goal of the command is to end process job activity as soon as possible. This includes halting all processing of material in progress, which may result in an unknown material condition. Abort is intended for use when serious problems are detected and further damage needs to be prevented. The abort command terminates the process job.

===== [p131-131] CAPABILITIES AND SCENARIOS > • ALARM (1块) =====
--[p131]-- Any abnormal situation that may endanger people, system, or material being processed.
Presence of an alarm inhibits further processing.

===== [p82-82] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > In Figure 2.14 three situations are described: (3块) =====
--[p82]-- 1. In the first situation a carrier is loaded onto the load port without an earlier Bind or Reservation. In that case there will be no reservation-phase; the load port is immediately associated with the carrier after having read the carrier ID.
2. The second situation shows that when a Reservation is used for the load port, the load port does not yet know the ID of the carrier to be received. In that situation the load port will be reserved, but not associated (ID is not known).
--[p82]-- (Note that in the situation an other ID is read than the one received in the Bind, the port remains associated. The association is now only to an other ID after the ID Read).
--[p82]-- In that situation the load port will be reserved, but not associated (ID is not known).
At the moment of physical placement of the carrier, the reservation is gone and after the ID reading the port will be associated as in the first situation.
3. The third situation shows that when using a Bind, the port is immediately Reserved as well as Associated (ID is known). The physical receipt of the carrier will then end the reservation phase, while the association keeps on to be valid.

===== [p24-24] RELEASE UPGRADE > Object Services Standard: Concepts, Behavior, and Services (SEMI E39) (1块) =====
--[p24]-- The purpose of the Object Services Standard is to provide general terminology, conventions, and notation for description of behavior and data in terms of objects and object attributes. In addition it provides basic services for reading object attributes, setting their values, and for asking for an object’s contents. This standard is intended to be referenced by other standards which define specific objects to reduce redundancy.

===== [p53-53] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • • • • WAFER EXPOSURE (1块) =====
--[p53]-- A wafer is on a stage being exposed. At the moment there is a wafer in this phase the machine will always be in this state (when the super-state is PROCESS). It is ignored that at the same time other wafers are being loaded and/or unloaded, etc. If exceptions during this phase occur the system will go to a PAUSE state regardless of those other activities as well.

===== [p150-150] CAPABILITIES AND SCENARIOS > Communication faults (1块) =====
--[p150]-- A communication fault occurs when the system does not receive an expected message, or when either a transaction timer or a conversation timer expires.
A transaction timeout period begins after the successful transmission of a complete primary message for which a reply is expected. See SEMI E37 for a full definition of a transaction timeout.
Conversation time-out is not applicable. There are no coupled transactions to which the system will give a time-out.

===== [p161-161] CAPABILITIES AND SCENARIOS > Track Interface window (3块) =====
--[p161]-- The Track Interface window is opened from the Other Functions menu in the TWINSCAN Navigation Manager window. (If Linked Litho is set to OFF in the SX Machine Constants, the Track Interface option in the Other Functions menu is grayed and cannot be selected).
When the Track Interface window opens (Figure 4.4), it starts with the current configuration settings. Use the radio buttons to change the configuration:
• Track input to Enable or Disable.
--[p161]-- • Track input to Enable or Disable.
Enable: a TransferSubstrateObject message is expected prior to the physical transfer of a wafer from track to TWINSCAN
Disable: no message is expected prior to the physical transfer of a wafer from track to TWINSCAN)
• Track output to Enable or Disable.
Enable: a TransferSubstrateObject message is send to the track prior to the physical transfer of a wafer from TWINSCAN to track
--[p161]-- Disable: no message is sent prior to the physical transfer of a wafer from TWINSCAN to track) Select Cancel to ignore the settings and close the window.
If the drivers are not started the Track input and Track output push buttons are grayed and disabled.

===== [p64-64] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > PROCESS JOB QUEUE States (1块) =====

===== [p68-68] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > STOP LOT (1块) =====
--[p68]-- A process job stop command is issued to stop a process job at any time. The stop command terminates the process job in an orderly manner. The intention of the stop command is to terminate the process job at the next safe, convenient point, preserving material integrity.

===== [p49-49] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • RESERVED (2块) =====
--[p49]-- The ASML(-authorized) engineer has started to solve a problem found.
• UPGRADE
An ASML(-authorized) engineer wants to install an upgrade.
• INVESTIGATE
An ASML(-authorized) engineer is busy with engineering activities on request of the customer (e.g. for joint development, new product introduction, etc.).
--[p49]-- The system is reserved for maintenance actions.
There are a number of specific maintenance actions for which the system can be reserved. These are:
• PREVENTIVE
An ASML(-authorized) engineer wants to execute Preventive Maintenance.
• MODIFY
An ASML(-authorized) engineer wants to modify the system to achieve the agreed specifications for the system.
• SYSTEM CHECK
An ASML(-authorized) engineer wants to investigate a machine problem (intermittent problem, etc.).
• CORRECTIVE

===== [p96-96] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • NOT ALLOCATED (1块) =====
--[p96]-- The reticle is not allocated to any physical action that is pending or in progress (e.g. a process job in the queue, move reticle or IRIS inspection).

===== [p70-70] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • ABORTED (1块) =====
--[p70]-- The active process job has been terminated abruptly and uncontrolled. All wafers are cleared from the machine. Aborted lots are considered being removed from the active queue.

===== [p81-81] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > RETICLE LOAD PORT RESERVATION State Model (2块) =====
--[p81]-- This state model is available only for reticle load ports.
RETICLE LOAD PORT RESERVATION States
• NOT RESERVED
There is no reservation existing at the load port.
• RESERVED
RETICLE LOAD PORT is reserved for future activity. In this state the access mode of the load port may not be changed.
--[p81]-- The load port reservation state model indicates if a load port is reserved for future activity. This is done in situations where the access mode is Auto and the factory control system already knows that a delivery will be due. In that case the load port cannot be switched to Manual any more by a local operator wanting to use the same port. When the load port is occupied by a carrier, the load port is always not reserved. This state model is available only for reticle load ports.

--[p113]-- With this service the host associates a Pod ID to a load port. By this the load port will be reserved for receiving this specific reticle pod. This enables 'equipment based verification' of the Pod ID at the moment the pod arrives on the load port.

===== [p157-158] CAPABILITIES AND SCENARIOS > Remote operation window (4块) =====
--[p157]-- The Remote Operation window is opened from the Other Functions menu in the TWINSCAN Navigation Manager window. The user then selects the applicable radio buttons (see Figure 4.1) to configure the system as follows:
• The control state
• The access type
• The communication state
When the remote operation window opens, it starts with the current configuration settings.
Use the radio buttons to change the configuration:
--[p158]-- The control state model and the communication state model do not have any interaction. Since the control state is changed via a SECS message, the control state can be effectively changed if, and only if, the communications state states COMMUNICATING in the title area of the TWINSCAN Navigation Window.
--[p158]-- Control to Online or Offline (Offline, the host has no control; Online, the host is able to take control)
Access to Local or Remote (Local, the operator has control but the host can request reports; Remote, the host has full control)
Communication to Enable or Disable (Disabled, there is no communication between TWINSCAN and host; Enabled, communications is established).
Use the OK button to activate the selected configuration.
--[p158]-- Use the OK button to activate the selected configuration.
If the activation of the settings is accepted, the Remote Operation window closes. If the settings are not activated an error message shows Unable to apply the configured settings. When you select the OK button (in the error dialog window) the dialog window closes.
Push the Cancel button to ignore the settings and close the window.
The default control state, communications state and access type during startup can be configured by the Machine Constants for the system.

===== [p44-44] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > SPOOLING State Model (2块) =====
--[p44]-- The spooling of individual messages can either be set to on or to off.
For this purpose, a spooling state model that indicates the behavior of the spool has been introduced.
--[p44]-- Spooling enables the system to queue primary messages that cannot be sent to the host immediately because of a communication failure. The secondary messages, replies sent to the host as a response to a primary message from the host, will not be spooled. The messages will be queued to be sent after the communication has been re-established. Stream 1 messages cannot be spooled. The spooling of individual messages can either be set to on or to off.

===== [p140-140] CAPABILITIES AND SCENARIOS > For the TWINSCAN system the material transfer concerns: (3块) =====
--[p140]-- Reticles. An interface is provided to load/unload and make reticle pods inventory at the reticle port(s). Reticles can also be transferred to/from reticle pods and the Internal Reticle Library (IRL) with separate commands. Automatic transport may be possible with conveyors.
Wafers via track. The communication between track and stepper is at the micro level. An electromechanical interface (parallel I/O) for transferring wafers is provided.
--[p140]-- WIP tracking monitors the location of all material in the system and the WIP state.
The host is notified when material is sent or received from a port or moved internally based on state transitions of:
• Load ports
• Reticle pods
• Reticles
• Wafer carriers
• Wafers
The host can obtain information about the material using separate requests:
• Inventory of reticle pod (list of reticle IDs)
• Status and position of material (carrier, reticle or wafer)
--[p140]-- An electromechanical interface (parallel I/O) for transferring wafers is provided.
The track interface may be enhanced to obtain/send additional information, such as wafer IDs, from/to the track, enabling such functionality is controlled by the track message input/output state model.
• Wafers via cassette. A local operator interface is provided to load/unload wafer cassettes at the wafer ports.
WIP tracking monitors the location of all material in the system and the WIP state.

In this access mode state only automated transfer of carriers is allowed.

===== [p103-103] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > RETICLE POD / SLOT Integrity (2块) =====
--[p103]-- If a reticle is selected for inspection or production, the reticle stays linked with its original reticle pod and slot. This is called primary association. At the moment the inspection or production is completed, the reticle returns to this original location. This is called pod / slot Integrity.
--[p103]-- This is called pod / slot Integrity.
But if a reticle is moved from a pod to the Internal Reticle Library (IRL), and the reticle is selected for inspection or production from this IRL-position, the reticle will be linked to the IRL-position from which it was taken. This is called secondary association.

--[p69]-- The last Wafer of the process job has been exposed and has to be moved towards the output position. In this state also the optional post-inspection of the Reticle takes place.

===== [p94-94] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > Service Queueing (1块) =====

===== [p114-114] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > CancelPod (4块) =====
--[p114]-- When a Reticle inside the equipment exists that is outside the pod and not in the IRL and has a secondary association with the Pod while a reticle that is associated to an other Pod resides on the robot, the service is rejected with an error.
--[p114]-- When a Reticle inside the equipment exists that is outside the pod and not on the stage or in the IRL and has a secondary association with the pod and the robot does NOT contain a reticle that is associated with an other pod, the reticle is returned to the Pod.
The pod must be prepared for removal by means of ending all activities related to the pod as described above, followed by unclamping (if no host-based pod release).
--[p114]-- Command to cancel the current reticle pod related action.
When the equipment is making an inventory to determine the Content-Map via reading the Reticle barcode(s), the barcode reading for an individual Reticle is completed and this Reticle is returned into their associated storage location inside the Pod after the scan. Barcode readings for Reticles not yet scanned will be continued until the inventory is complete.
--[p114]-- Barcode readings for Reticles not yet scanned will be continued until the inventory is complete.
• When a Reticle is being transferred from/to the Pod, this transfer is completed first.
When Reticles inside the equipment exist with status IN USE (regardless of whether the reticle is in the Pod or being moved to the Pod or not), the service will be rejected (Command not valid in current state) (see: 2.8.7).

===== [p45-45] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • • • TRANSMIT SPOOL (1块) =====
--[p45]-- The number of messages sent from the spool to the host at the same time is limited by the MAXSPOOLTRANSMIT equipment constant. The oldest messages is sent first. The host must request a spooled message unload repeatedly if more messages are spooled than the MAXSPOOLTRANSMIT constant permits. When a message is sent, the value of the SV SPOOLCOUNTACTUAL decreases by 1.

===== [p45-45] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • SPOOL LOAD (1块) =====
--[p45]-- All selected primary messages will be directed to the spool to be sent later.

===== [p93-93] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > CancelMoveReticle (1块) =====
--[p93]-- Cancels a MoveReticle provided it has not yet started.

===== [p157-157] CAPABILITIES AND SCENARIOS > User interface (2块) =====
--[p157]-- Remote Operation uses the following windows:
• The Remote Operation Window
• The Terminal Services Window
• The Track Interface Window.
The Remote Operation window lets the user set the Control state, the Access state and the Communication state for control by a remote host.
The Terminal Services window lets the user read messages sent by the host and send messages to the host.
--[p157]-- The Track Interface window lets the user control the sending of wafer track messages that communicate the waferID to be transferred.
The Control State and the Communication State of the SECS interface are always shown in the title area of the Navigation Manager. The communication state of the track interface is only noted in the ER event log and not visible on the GUI.

===== [p42-42] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • ATTEMPT ON-LINE (1块) =====
--[p42]-- While the ATTEMPT ON-LINE state is active, the equipment has responded to an operator instruction to attempt to go to the ON-LINE state. Upon activating this state, the equipment attempts to send an S1,F1 to the host.

===== [p68-68] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > PAUSE LOT (1块) =====
--[p68]-- A process job that is active in the system is paused. A pause command causes the processing resource to continue to the first safe, continual, pausing place and then cease activity. The activity may cease only at points where resuming activity is allowed such that material integrity is maintained and the processing goals are accomplished. A paused process job can also be stopped or aborted in addition to resumed.

===== [p203-203] CAPABILITIES AND SCENARIOS > TID (1块) =====
--[p203]-- Description Terminal number, 1 byte. Values 0 = Single or main terminal >0 = Additional terminals at the same equipment Where Used S10F1, F3, F5, F7

===== [p53-53] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • • • • WAFER PREPARE (1块) =====
--[p53]-- The wafer is being prepared for exposure (aligned, measured) while no (other) wafer is being in the exposure or image prepare phase.

===== [p81-81] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > RETICLE LOAD PORT ASSOCIATION State Model (1块) =====
--[p81]-- The Reticle load port / carrier association model indicates if a load port is related to a specific carrier. When the load port is occupied by a carrier for which the ID can be read, the load port is associated by definition.

===== [p7-7] Product Documentation > The Harel convention (1块) =====
--[p7]-- The Harel convention is, as in all applicable SEMI standards, used to describe state models.

===== [p51-51] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • SYSTEM\_OK (1块) =====
--[p51]-- The system checks on subsystem availability and state are successful, no exceptions with severity warning, error or alarm exist and only material that relates to existing lots or no material at all is available in the INIT state. This is a prerequisite for further processing.

===== [p44-44] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • POWER ON (1块) =====
--[p44]-- The power of the equipment has been switched on. Spooling will return to the same state as where it was during the last POWER OFF.

===== [p102-102] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > Inventory Mode (1块) =====
--[p102]-- See transition J reticle pod state model (part 2).

===== [p68-68] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > DELETE LOT (1块) =====
--[p68]-- A process job that is queued in the system is cancelled and removed from the queue.

===== [p96-104] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • ID VERIFICATION FAILED (2块) =====
--[p96]-- The Reticle verification by the host or the equipment failed and the reticle cannot be used. It cannot be inserted in the system and it is only allowed to move this reticle from one Pod to another.
--[p104]-- This state is active whenever the pod ID has been rejected via a CancelPod service by the host.

===== [p131-131] CAPABILITIES AND SCENARIOS > • ERROR (1块) =====
--[p131]-- Any abnormal situation but without direct danger for people, system, or material. In error situations, further processing is not possible (mostly because the system is waiting for material, operator, or host).

===== [p115-115] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > PodTagWriteData (1块) =====
--[p115]-- With PodTagWriteData information can be written onto the Tag by the Host. In a specific case the Host or Operator can instruct the equipment to write the Content-Map (as known by the equipment) into the Tag. The data written onto the Tag in this way will not be interpreted and used by the equipment.

===== [p69-69] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • • AWAITING WAFERS (1块) =====
--[p69]-- For the process job all reticles are qualified and the process job is waiting for the first wafer to reach the input port of the system.

===== [p54-54] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • • ATTENDED BY ASML (1块) =====
--[p54]-- An ASML(-authorized) engineer is available for handling the situation, or, after analysis of the situation has escalated internally in ASML, or the system waits for material, track, etc.

===== [p103-103] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > Reticle Pod State Models (2块) =====
--[p103]-- Reticles are loaded or unloaded from the system, using a SMIF box which contains one to six reticles. Once the reticle pod is loaded and locked the reticle(s) in the reticle pod are identified. This can be done by taking each reticle out of the reticle pod, reading its identification and restoring it in the reticle pod.
Reticles will be loaded or unloaded from the reticle stage when needed. This will be done automatically depending on the contents of the recipe used at the time.
--[p103]-- This will be done automatically depending on the contents of the recipe used at the time.
There are two reticle ports where SMIF boxes can be placed.

===== [p106-106] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • • POD-BUSY-SLOTMAP (1块) =====
--[p106]-- The SlotMap of the Pod is being determined by checking Reticle presence at each slot or the equipment is waiting for input from the host on the slotmap just read.

===== [p64-64] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • HALTED CALIBRATION (1块) =====
--[p64]-- The queue processing is halted for automatic calibrations between process jobs.
• • HALTED CONDITION The queue processing is halted because there are warnings about the process conditions.

===== [p52-52] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • • ALARM PAUSE (1块) =====
--[p52]-- The processing is stopped because of a detected alarm or error situation (machine detected failure or operator found 'symptom') that prohibits normal processing (unscheduled down). See definitions for meaning of symptom.

===== [p39-39] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • DISABLED (1块) =====
--[p39]-- The equipment cannot communicate with the host. The TCP/IP connection cannot be established, and there is no connected HSMS session. In this state, the system will not interact with the network.

===== [p113-113] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > CancelBind (1块) =====
--[p113]-- The host cancels an earlier given Bind command indicating the earlier specified reticle pod will not be directed to the load port anymore.

===== [p69-69] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • • LOADING (1块) =====
--[p69]-- Production of the process job is started and the first Wafer(s) are moved via the prealigner and load robot towards the stage(s).

===== [p115-115] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > PodRelease (1块) =====
--[p115]-- Pod is being released for potential removal. Note that this command is only allowed when the pod is COMPLETE (see Pod Accessing Status) and locked ¡V POD HOLD (See Pod Locking Status). This requires that the factory constant PodRelease Control is set to ‘Host’.

===== [p64-64] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • PRODUCTION DISABLED (1块) =====
--[p64]-- Lots are available but the production was stopped or must stop after the completion of the process job that is currently processing.

===== [p51-51] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • IDLE (1块) =====
--[p51]-- System is initialized without error (system check was successful) and production is enabled. Only a number of completed Process jobs may still exist in the queue (all having Process job State STOPPED, ABORTED or FULLY PROCESSED; these completed jobs are not part of the active queue anymore.

===== [p77-77] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > RETICLE LOAD PORT State Model (1块) =====
--[p77]-- RETICLE LOAD PORT is a location on the system where the operator, or an automated transport system, can place or remove reticle carriers. Each system has two numbered load ports for reticles. The left-hand port is numbered 101 and the right-hand port is numbered 102.

===== [p105-105] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • SLOT MAP VERIFICATION OK (1块) =====
--[p105]-- The SlotMap verification by either equipment or host was successful.

===== [p162-162] CAPABILITIES AND SCENARIOS > SX Machine Constants (2块) =====
--[p162]-- The SECS interfaces are configurable through the SX Machine Constants. These constants are grouped in four tabs:
1. Host Interface Settings
2. Track Interface Settings
3. General Settings
4. Compatibility Settings
It is possible to change the Machine Constants for SX while the communication state is COMMUNICATING. In this case the operator can decide via the ER exception handling window to activate the settings immediately or not.
--[p162]-- In case the settings are activated immediately, the SECS interface will be disabled and enabled with the new settings. During this reset all communication and state information (like e.g. outstanding messages) will be lost. If the operator chooses not to activate the settings immediately, they will be applied during the next TWINSCAN software start.

===== [p47-47] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • AWAITING TRACK (1块) =====
--[p47]-- The repair / validation cannot be completed because the Track cannot deliver wafers.

===== [p70-70] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • • Processed Wafers Cleared (1块) =====
--[p70]-- Wafers of the process job that were staged are moved out of the equipment after being exposed. The system now waits for the Clear process job command. This state will only be reached in manual operation and is introduced to give the user a chance to be able to stop both scanner and track independently from each other. When under host control both pieces of equipment can be stopped at the same time and for that reason there is no reason for entering this state.

===== [p52-52] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • • • SET-UP PREPARE (1块) =====
--[p52]-- System executes the set-up activities and waits for the first wafer.
• • • • SET-UP CHECK
The system status is being checked right before the first wafer is allowed to enter. If necessary due M-actions are triggered to achieve the appropriate processing conditions needed for production.

===== [p96-96] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • • UNQUALIFIED RETICLE (1块) =====
--[p96]-- Reticle is being verified or has been rejected and cannot be used for production (except for some specific cases).

===== [p118-118] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • (IN/OUT-)ENABLED (1块) =====
--[p118]-- In this state the wafer messages are transferred and accepted in order to enable the physical transfer. This means that if the communication is not established or whenever the message received indicates a conflict between track and scanner, the physical transfer will be prevented and an exception will be raised to the user via means of the ER interface window.
The Message input/output state transitions are listed in the table below.

===== [p53-53] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • • • • IMAGE PREPARE (2块) =====
--[p53]-- A wafer is available on the expose position and all necessary preparations to start the next image (except wafer preparations, see: wafer prepare) on this wafer are executed in this state. This means that an aligned reticle must be available to enable the completion of the next exposure.
At the moment there is a wafer in this phase the machine will always be in this state (when the super-state is PROCESS).
--[p53]-- It is ignored that at the same time other wafers are being loaded and/or unloaded, etc. If exceptions during this phase occur the system will go to a PAUSE state regardless of those other activities as well.

===== [p94-94] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > Re-qualifyReticleDone (S14F21 completion event) (1块) =====
--[p94]-- Since the Re-qualifyReticle service requires time to execute, this separate completion service (S14F21) to the Host is defined to indicate the service has been executed including indication of (not) success.

===== [p52-52] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • • SETTING UP (2块) =====
--[p52]-- Activities to set-up the exposure for a next job are completed in this phase (they could already be started earlier). Set-up activities: Inform Handlers about the job, resolve and qualify reticle(s). To end setting up also the first wafer must have arrived (when applicable; e.g a2 test process job may not need a wafer) at the input port (the first wafer is not yet inserted(!) into the machine within this state).
--[p52]-- In this state a typical transition to PROCESS PAUSE can be found if the needed first wafer or reticle(s) are not physically available at the moment the mentioned set-up activities are completed (system is hampered by material not being available). At the moment the reticle(s) and the first wafer are available, the system will have to check its status before transitioning to a next state in the situation where the Process job can be started automatically.

===== [p96-96] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • • • RETICLE PRESENT (1块) =====
--[p96]-- The reticle is waiting to be selected for qualification or to be removed again (for Reticles which will not be used inside the equipment, but which are only instantiated by means of a Bind or Notification service with a ContentMap).

===== [p159-159] CAPABILITIES AND SCENARIOS > Terminal Services window (1块) =====
--[p159]-- The Terminal Services window is opened from the Other Functions menu in the Navigation Manager window. The Terminal Services has two message windows.
The top part of the window shows the text of incoming messages and the bottom part of the window shows the text of outgoing messages. (See also Figure 4.2)
Scroll bars let the user scroll through messages that are too large for the view windows.
There is a maximum message length of 1600 characters.

===== [p96-96] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • • QUALIFIED RETICLE (1块) =====
--[p96]-- The reticle may be used for production.

===== [p6-6] Product Documentation > WHO THIS BOOK IS FOR (1块) =====
--[p6]-- This document describes the Semiconductor Equipment Communications Standard (SECS) interface for the TWINSCAN software release 5.0.0.
This manual provides an overall description and detailed information about the functioning of the SECS interface. The manual is aimed at a wide audience, including those involved in implementing a SECS communication link. To understand the knowledge in this manual, a basic understanding of data communication systems is necessary.

===== [p68-68] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > CANCEL LOT (1块) =====
--[p68]-- A process job that has not yet become active and is still queued, is canceled but not removed from the queue. This does not affect other process jobs queued, nor does it affect process jobs active in the system.

===== [p52-52] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • • • READY WAIT (1块) =====
--[p52]-- Equipment is waiting for the start command.

===== [p45-45] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • SPOOL UNLOAD (1块) =====
--[p45]-- The system either transmits the spool or waits for the host to send an S6F23 message to start spool transmission or spool purging.

===== [p78-78] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • • (UN-)LOADING (1块) =====
--[p78]-- The carrier is being loaded or unloaded.

===== [p105-105] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • POD-NOT-ACCESSED (1块) =====
--[p105]-- The Pod has not yet been received or is not yet being clamped / opened for further processing.

===== [p94-94] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > SetQualification-IntervalTime (1块) =====

This service is not available on the NXE platform.

===== [p90-90] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • COMPLETE, UNLOADED (1块) =====
--[p90]-- The wafer carrier is unloaded and is available for transfer.

===== [p42-42] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • EQUIPMENT OFF-LINE (1块) =====
--[p42]-- While this state is active, the system maintains the OFF-LINE state. It awaits operator instructions to attempt to go ON-LINE.

===== [p85-85] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • PROCESSING COMPLETE (1块) =====
--[p85]-- Super-state of PROCESSED, REJECTED, ABORTED, LOST, SKIPPED or STOPPED. The handling of the wafer has completed.

===== [p53-53] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • • • UNLOAD (1块) =====
--[p53]-- For non test-lots: (In most cases after removal from the stage) wafers are moved towards the output port. No further wafers on the wafer stages are found.
For test lots: The system should transition to the appropriate next state immediately.

===== [p106-106] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • POD LOCKING STATUS (1块) =====
--[p106]-- Indication of the current locking status with following possible states:

===== [p52-52] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • • EXECUTING (1块) =====
--[p52]-- • • • • LOAD
For non test jobs: A wafer is retrieved from the input port, pre-aligned and moved towards the stage(s) while at that same moment there are no (other) staged wafers nor wafers being unloaded.
For test jobs: The system should transition to state WORKING immediately.

===== [p70-70] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • CLEARING AFTER ABORT (1块) =====
--[p70]-- In this state the equipment is having material related to this process job inside the machine. This material has to be moved out with a special recovery procedure using the Material Handler (user interface).

===== [p89-89] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • IN ACCESS (1块) =====
--[p89]-- The wafer carrier is loaded into the system and cannot be transferred.
• • CLOSED, LOADED
The carrier is loaded, but not yet locked and opened.

===== [p42-42] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • ON-LINE (2块) =====
--[p42]-- • • LOCAL
The operator has full control of the system. All host commands to control the machine (remote commands that cause physical movements or commands that initiate or otherwise influence the wafer exposure process) will be rejected with SxF. However, the host can retrieve data from the system and enter the parameters for data retrieval.
--[p42]-- However, the host can retrieve data from the system and enter the parameters for data retrieval.
Functions such as updating equipment constants, downloading of process job definitions or other remote commands for process job execution and material control are disabled in local mode.

===== [p54-54] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • (TO BE) ATTENDED BY ASML ENGINEER (1块) =====
--[p54]-- Problem needs to be solved by ASML.

===== [p102-102] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > RETICLE POD State Model (1块) =====

===== [p78-78] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • • READY TO UNLOAD (1块) =====
--[p78]-- A carrier is present on the load port. It is available for unloading because it is not used.

===== [p64-64] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • PRODUCTION ENABLED (1块) =====
--[p64]-- The production of process jobs is running or can be started or resumed.

===== [p68-68] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > START LOT (1块) =====
--[p68]-- A process job that has the process start attribute not set is started using the START LOT command. This allows the processing of the material to proceed when the processing resource is available. The START LOT command may be issued when the lot is created and in state READY TO RUN.

===== [p95-95] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • RETICLE ID STATUS (1块) =====

===== [p23-23] RELEASE UPGRADE > Figure 1.1 Equipment context (2块) =====
--[p23]-- Relevant state models can be found in “COMMUNICATIONS State Model” on page 40, “WAFER LOCATION State Model” on page 88, and “MESSAGE INPUT / OUTPUT State Model (Linked Litho)” on page 119.
--[p23]-- The TWINSCAN interfaces via SECS with:
• The host
This is the standard control / data interface of the equipment.
• The track
Via this interface wafer information is transferred between track and scanner, synchronized with the physical wafer flow (Linked Litho).
This manual describes only the TWINSCAN – Host interface, but the states of the track interface will also be reported towards the host.

===== [p41-41] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • OFF-LINE (2块) =====
--[p41]-- While OFF-LINE, the equipment will respond with an Sx,F0 to any primary message from the host other than S1,F13 or S1,F17. It will process and respond to S1,F13 and S1,F17 only, unless it is in sub-state ATTEMPT ON-LINE. S1,F17 is used by host to request the equipment to transition to the ON-LINE state. The equipment will accept this request and send a positive response only when the HOST OFF-LINE state is active.
OFF-LINE has three substates: EQUIPMENT OFF-LINE, ATTEMPT ON-LINE and HOST OFF-LINE.
--[p41]-- When the OFF-LINE state is active, operation of the equipment is performed by the operator at the operator console. While the equipment is OFF-LINE, message transfer is possible. However the use of messaging for automation purposes is severely restricted. While the OFF-LINE state is active, the equipment will only respond to those messages used for the establishment of communications or a host request to activate the ON-LINE state.

===== [p90-90] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • COMPLETE, OPEN (1块) =====
--[p90]-- The wafer carrier is empty (when carrier is for input only), full (when carrier is used for output) or the last wafer of a process job has been processed (in the situation where the carrier is used for receipt of good wafers or it is used for receipt of reject wafers together with a factory constant indicating that only one process job per Carrier is allowed).
This state can also be reached at the moment the slot verification fails or the carrier has been cancelled otherwise while being in state IN ACCESS.

===== [p54-54] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • OPERATOR AVAILABLE (1块) =====
--[p54]-- In this state the Operator is available to handle the situation.

This capability provides a means of formally establishing communications following system initialization or any loss of communications between communicating partners, and thus of notifying the communication partner that a period of non-communication has occurred.

===== [p95-95] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • ID READ FAIL (1块) =====
--[p95]-- The barcode of the reticle could not be read.

===== [p54-54] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • • WAIT ASML ENGINEER (1块) =====
--[p54]-- Problem is escalated to ASML, system waits for the ASML(-authorized) engineer’s arrival.

===== [p96-96] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • ALLOCATED (1块) =====
--[p96]-- The reticle is allocated to at least one physical action that is pending or in progress. When the reticle is inside a pod, the reticle status will prevent removal from the system by means of locking a pod which, if necessary, can be overruled with the CancelPod Service.

===== [p95-95] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > ReticleIDVerification (1块) =====
--[p95]-- TRUE: The Reticle ID must be verified with information as provided by the Host.
FALSE: No Reticle ID verification, meaning that the Reticle ID as found will be accepted. This is most likely to be used in factories without full Reticle and Pod Management support.

===== [p93-93] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > MoveReticleDone (S14F21 completion event) (1块) =====
--[p93]-- Since the MoveReticle service requires time to execute, this separate completion service (S14F21) to the Host is defined to indicate the service has been executed including indication of (not) success.

===== [p44-44] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • SPOOL INACTIVE (1块) =====
--[p44]-- Normal operating mode. No spooling occurs and the spool area is empty. The system is able to transmit primary messages to the host.

===== [p78-78] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • • READY TO LOAD (1块) =====
--[p78]-- The load port is available to be loaded with an external carrier. No carrier is loaded on the port.

===== [p94-94] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > OkToUseReticle (1块) =====
--[p94]-- Indication of the user that the Reticle may be used even though inspection results are not OK according the inspection reject criteria. When auto-inspection is enabled, a new inspection based on expiration will almost certain result into the same rejection. When IRIS automated inspections is active and the inspection timer for that reticle is not set to 0 (infinite), the timer will be re-activated upon service receipt.
This service is not available on the NXE platform.

===== [p95-95] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > RETICLE STATE States (1块) =====
--[p95]-- A reticle has the following parallel state models:
– Reticle ID Status (indicates the verification status of the reticle ID.)
– Reticle Allocation Status (shows if the reticle is assigned to a process job in the process job queue or being moved or being re-qualified)
– Reticle Qualification Status (indicates the current qualification status)

===== [p102-102] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > RETICLE POD State Model > 1. Single Reticle Pods (1块) =====
--[p102]-- Can contain only one reticle.

===== [p52-52] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • PAUSE (1块) =====
--[p52]-- The processing is being paused, stopped or aborted either on request of the Operator / Host or by the detection of an error situation.

===== [p131-131] CAPABILITIES AND SCENARIOS > • WARNING (1块) =====
--[p131]-- Any abnormal situation, not severe enough to impact active jobs (see Alarm, Error), but serious enough to prevent the starting of a new job.

===== [p52-52] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • • PROCESS PAUSE (1块) =====
--[p52]-- The processing is paused on request of the Operator or the processing is waiting for material, reticles or information from Operator or Host (stand-by).

===== [p20-20] RELEASE UPGRADE > SUMMARY (1块) =====
--[p20]-- This chapter briefly explains the SEMI standards, the protocol, and the compliance statements.

===== [p42-42] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • HOST OFF-LINE (1块) =====
--[p42]-- While the HOST OFF-LINE state is active, the operator’s intent is that the equipment be ON-LINE. However, the host has not agreed. Entry to this state may be due to a failed attempt to go ON-LINE or to the host’s request that the equipment go OFF-LINE from ON-LINE. While this state is active, the equipment shall positively respond to any host’s request to go ON-LINE.

===== [p96-96] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • • • QUALIFIED (1块) =====
--[p96]-- The reticle is qualified and stored on a known position in the system or reticle pod.

===== [p96-96] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • • • REJECTED (1块) =====
--[p96]-- The reticle did not pass the qualification(s) (yet) and is therefor not suited for normal production. When the ID verification fails, or the Reticle has been rejected by service, the reticle may not be used at all. In case of reticles failing inspection, the operator or the host (depending on the control mode) will have to decide if the reticle must be re-qualified or removed from the system.

===== [p47-47] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • AWAITING LASER (1块) =====
--[p47]-- The repair / validation cannot be completed because the Laser is not operational.

===== [p96-96] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • RETICLE QUALIFICATION STATUS (1块) =====
--[p96]-- The Qualification Status combines the ID Status and Inspection Status in order to determine if the Reticle is qualified to be used for production.

===== [p49-49] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • RESERVATION (1块) =====
--[p49]-- • • NOT RESERVED
The system is not reserved for maintenance actions.

===== [p106-106] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • POD-LOCKED (1块) =====
--[p106]-- In this state a pod has been locked to the reticle port and it can be accessed by the equipment.

===== [p51-51] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • SYSTEM\_CHECK (2块) =====
--[p51]-- This will then lead to SYSTEM\_OK; on the other hand if the material situation is different than expected, the check will fail and material has to be cleared which is done in substate SYSTEM\_NOK.
--[p51]-- In this state the system-state is being checked to verify if the system is technically ready for the execution of tasks; if necessary, (on-line) calibrations are done. Next to that the material status is verified. If the material status found is identical to the situation before the reset/restart of the system, production may resume by starting further processing on this material (system recovery).

===== [p106-106] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • • POD-BUSY (2块) =====
--[p106]-- It cannot be removed until the requested reticle movements are completed, the associated reticles inside the equipment are replaced into the secondary association location unless overruled by the CancelPod service given by either host or operator.
--[p106]-- In this state a reticle pod has been locked to the reticle port, there are allocations for reticle(s) inside the Pod, there are requested moves for reticle(s) inside the Pod, there are requested inspections for reticle(s) inside the Pod or there are reticles inside the machine that have a secondary association to locations in the pod.

===== [p24-24] RELEASE UPGRADE > Note (1块) =====
--[p24]-- Control Job Management (SEMI E94) is not implemented since the primary wafer interface for a TWINSCAN is a wafer track instead of a wafer carrier.
Carrier Management (SEMI E87) is not implemented since the primary wafer interface for a TWINSCAN is a wafer track instead of a wafer carrier.

===== [p124-124] CAPABILITIES AND SCENARIOS (1块) =====

• Events or exceptions are triggered by the system and sent to the Host.
• If the Host wants to send a multi-block message, the multi-block Inquire message is optional. If inquired, it will always be accepted (granted).
• The system sends all required multi-block Inquire-messages to the host (if required).
The general scenario layout is:
Scenario . Scenario title
Information that is sent or received by the Host | ←SxxFxx
Information that is sent or received by the Host | ←SxxFxx
SxxFxx→ Information that is sent or received by the system

===== [p90-90] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • SLOTS-VERIFIED (1块) =====

--[p52]-- The Equipment is waiting for a start process job command from host or operator to start running. When the start command is received, the system’s status must be checked before the Process job can be really started.

There are no allocated reticles inside the pod or reticles with status IN USE that have a secondary association with a location in the pod, there are no requested moves for reticle(s) inside the Pod there are no requested inspections for reticle(s) inside the Pod.

===== [p78-78] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • TRANSFER BLOCKED (1块) =====
--[p78]-- The carrier, which is available on the load port, is in use or loaded or unloaded.

===== [p24-24] RELEASE UPGRADE > Generic Equipment Model (SEMI E30) (1块) =====

===== [p44-44] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • POWER OFF (1块) =====
--[p44]-- The power to the system has been isolated (due to power fail or switched off).

===== [p77-77] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > RETICLE LOAD PORT Services (2块) =====
--[p77]-- UnClamp Unlocks the reticle pod.
The reticles cannot be transferred. The pod can be removed.
ReserveAtPort Reserves a load port for a particular reticle pod.
--[p77]-- The following commands apply to reticle load ports (or are affected by the reticle load port transfer state model):
Bind Assigns the load port to a specific wafer carrier / reticle Pod.
CancelBind Cancels bind command.
CancelReservationAtPort Cancels a reservation.
ChangeAccess Changes the load port’s acces mode.
ChangeServiceStatus Change the load port’s service status.
Clamp Locks the reticle pod to the system. The reticles can be transferred.
UnClamp Unlocks the reticle pod.

===== [p106-106] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • • POD-BUSY-INVENTORYING (1块) =====
--[p106]-- The reticle pod is locked for determination of the ContentMap. The ContentMap can be determined by reading the barcodes of the individual reticles. The reticles will be taken out of the Pod and after reading the barcode, re-inserted.

===== [p94-94] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > RejectReticle (1块) =====
--[p94]-- The qualification status of the Reticle is changed into REJECTED and in the situations where the Reticle ID verification was done by the Host in the state WAITING FOR HOST, the ID status will be changed into ID VERIFICATION FAILED.
This service is not available on the NXE platform.

===== [p96-96] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • RETICLE NOT PRESENT (1块) =====
--[p96]-- The reticle is not present on the Equipment.

===== [p48-48] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • AWAITING MATERIAL (1块) =====
--[p48]-- Repair / validation is not possible due to missing wafers or reticles.

===== [p84-84] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • PROCESSING (1块) =====
--[p84]-- • • NEEDS PROCESSING The wafer is still at the source position and is not yet picked up for further processing.

===== [p85-85] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • IN PROCESS (1块) =====
--[p85]-- Processing on the wafer is in progress. This includes measuring, exposure and wafer movements after leaving the stage.

===== [p54-54] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • SYSTEM HALTED (1块) =====
--[p54]-- System activities have come to a stop due to an exception with severity > notification.

===== [p47-47] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > SYSTEM State Model (1块) =====
--[p47]-- The SYSTEM state model describes how the system can be top-level controlled. Parallel state models, the SERVICE State sub-model and RESERVATION State sub-model are implemented in the SECS-interface.

===== [p96-96] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • • • • RETICLE CHECK (1块) =====
--[p96]-- The reticle is optionally being checked with IRIS. IRIS inspections may be triggered by Operator / Host or inspection result expiration.

===== [p84-84] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • AT WORK (1块) =====
--[p84]-- The wafer can be found inside the equipment (carrier is regarded 'outside' the equipment).

===== [p48-48] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • AWAITING CUSTOMER (1块) =====
--[p48]-- There are situations where the activities at the machine cannot continue due to reasons for which the Customer is responsible. Examples: Some facilities are not available, Engineer is requested to do other tasks, etc.

===== [p70-70] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • • PAUSED (1块) =====
--[p70]-- An active process job is paused and cannot be reactivated without a user / host decision.
• • • • PAUSED, validated
PROCESS JOB is paused and waiting to be resumed.
• • • • PAUSED, not validated
PROCESS JOB is being modified.
• • • • CHECKING
PROCESS JOB definition has been updated and the system must verify the changes made.

===== [p93-93] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > MoveReticle (2块) =====
--[p93]-- With this service a single reticle can be moved from one reticle location to an other reticle location. It is possible to queue several MoveReticle commands (max.12) which are executed on a FIFO-basis. During production (when the Lot Queue is enabled) a MoveReticle can only be used for moves to/ from IRL, IRIS or Reticle Pod locations.
MoveReticle requests will always be accepted (queued), provided that the reticle object is instantiated.
--[p93]-- At execution the reticle object status is checked against the command matrix. The service is rejected when the object is not in the correct state according to the command matrix. If the service request is accepted then the result of the service is returned via the S14F21 completion event.

===== [p88-88] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > Wafer QUALIFICATION State Model (1块) =====
--[p88]-- The wafer QUALIFICATION state model is a reflection of the possible wafer status: Is the wafer (still) OK for processing.

===== [p149-149] CAPABILITIES AND SCENARIOS > Message faults (1块) =====
--[p149]-- A message fault occurs when the system detects a defect in the message received, including the:
• Device ID
• Message stream
• Message function
• Message format/structure

===== [p105-105] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • • • POD-AVAILABLE (1块) =====
--[p105]-- After receipt of the pod on the load port it is still unlocked and closed. (The pod can still be removed). In this state the Pod ID verification is done.

===== [p64-64] FUNCTIONAL BEHAVIOR > • HALTED (1块) =====
--[p64]-- Production has to be stopped after finishing the process jobs inside the machine because of an internal detected reason (need for calibration or condition warning).
